name: Physician
overview: Scripture presents physicians both literally and figuratively, highlighting their role in physical and spiritual healing. While Asa sought help from physicians rather than the LORD during his illness (2 Chronicles 16:12), the Bible also acknowledges the limitations of human healers, as seen in the woman who worsened despite many physicians' care (Mark 5:26). Jesus used the metaphor of a physician to illustrate His mission to call sinners, not the self-righteous, to repentance (Matthew 9:12; Mark 2:17). Additionally, prophetic imagery questions the absence of true healing, asking if there is no balm or physician to restore health (Jeremiah 8:22), and warns against false healers who are worthless (Job 13:4).
